verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents extensive API/REST coverage plus client libraries and a full-featured gcloud CLI that itself wraps the APIs, strongly suggesting API-UI parity for core resource management (compute, IAM, billing, Terraform-based infra). However, the evidence pack doesn't confirm 100% parity across every console feature (e.g., some newer console-only UX like API hub dashboards or personalized health views aren't shown to have full API equivalents), and there's no independent audit confirming no UI-only gaps. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every console feature has an API/CLI equivalent, independent verification of full parity, coverage of edge-case console-only settings.
